resources.string: Your cloud bills, in your pocket
TollCat adds up what you spend on services like AWS, Cloudflare, and OpenAI, so you can see what this month has cost so far and roughly where it will end up.

You give each service its own read-only credential. When you refresh, this device asks that service’s official API for the bill directly. Nothing goes through a TollCat server, and there’s no account to sign up for.
API keys live in this device’s Keystore. They don’t leave with cloud backup. Move to a new phone with Import & Export in Settings.
Start by adding the services you use; credentials can come later. For a plan you only pay monthly, like ChatGPT Pro, entering the fee is enough.
